name: Scrambled Eggs
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 1, line cook 1

Flavor Profiles texture
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d4

DESCRIPTION

Scrambled eggs are beaten (sometimes with milk or water), then cooked until fluffy. When consumed, they grant a +1 circumstance bonus on ability checks and physical skill checks for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the bonus and serving size by +1 each, to a maximum of +1 per 2 levels.
